ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: A rodent population was studied over the course of 100 generations to examine changes in tooth enamel thickness. Species adapted to food resources requiring high levels of processing have thicker tooth enamel than species that eat soft, more easily processed foods. Use this information and the corresponding curves to answer: If one data point is randomly selected from the three groups of data (generation 1, generation 50, and generation 100), and that individual's tooth enamel thickness score is 15, then from which generations could that individual possibly come?
